methodology.series: Full UTC calendar days present in all four DeFiLlama feeds. Current UTC day excluded.
methodology.signer: Twenty-five fixed 1,000-parent-transaction-block windows spaced one million block heights apart; seven at fixed four-million-block intervals are fully hydrated. The four additional ranges were chosen before their method classification, but the samples are not random. Count deduplicated receipts whose receiver is v1.signer and method is sign. These receipts may execute after the parent transaction window. Excludes respond, verify, and cleanup. Windows are samples, not all-network totals or proof of outbound settlement.
methodology.day: Twelve nonoverlapping 1,000-parent-transaction-block windows starting at block 224000000 and spaced 12000 heights apart. Fixed before classifying the additional eleven windows. Approximately two-hour cadence across Nov 11 UTC; not continuous full-day coverage or a random sample. One window overlaps the historical seven-window audit.
